title: ha/dr: automate multi-AZ failover & restore drills (runbooks-as-code, helm, terraform, installer)
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: standardize and automate High-Availability and Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) runbooks for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) so operators can run repeatable multi-AZ failover and restore drills with minimal manual steps. This PR introduces runbooks-as-code, Terraform module updates for multi-AZ restore automation, Helm chart changes to enable controlled failover behavior, and installer hooks to orchestrate pre/post-drill validation. Summary of changes: 1) Add runbooks-as-code definitions that encode step-by-step drill procedures and verification checks; 2) Terraform: new modules and upgrade paths for snapshot-based restore and cross-AZ failover routing; 3) Helm: values and hooks to mark chart components as failover-aware and to expose health/prometheus checks for drill automation; 4) Private installer: add preflight + postflight tasks and a new "drill-controller" job for orchestrating restores in air-gapped/private setups. Checklist: - [x] runbooks-as-code DSL and YAML manifests added; - [x] terraform module + examples updated and tested against terraform 1.6; - [x] helm values + hooks validated in kind + multi-AZ kube cluster; - [x] installer integration and smoke tests; - [x] docs: runbook docs + quickstart for running a restore drill. Testing and validation: ran restore drills in our staging multi-AZ environment (az-a/az-b), validated KV cache warmup time, observed automatic routing fallback to a secondary AZ, and verified data restore integrity with sample datasets. CI: all unit/integration checks passed; e2e restore acceptance job was run as a gated job and marked successful. Backwards compatibility: changes are opt-in via new Helm values and terraform variables; migration instructions are included. Rollback story: installer adds an idempotent rollback step that reverses routing and re-applies previous Helm release. Related: references ENG-4123 (DR automation epic), ENG-4198 (runbook-as-code design).
